scope: Two supplied editable entity-availability policies, preserved independent availability assignments through integration outages, fixed-window reusable notification collections, exact notification issue links, and the authorized reset of recognized older configuration. Also includes the durable-state and failed-save reload changes committed since 1.9.0.

checks: Fresh Home Assistant installation and older-configuration reset

dependency.name: health-tree
dependency.source: Published PyPI package; non-editable installation verified

candidate.archive_source: Exact candidate CI artifact; published GitHub asset digest matches the verified archive

rendered_acceptance.change_reason: Setup-only settings replacement and release metadata; frontend source is unchanged from the accepted snapshot

upgrade.authorization: Maintainer explicitly requested overwriting the existing configuration instead of migration or a fresh-install-only prerelease.
upgrade.recognition: Otherwise-valid named notification settings with at least one non-report profile and collection delay absent from every non-report profile.
upgrade.result: Replace config-entry data with current defaults and clear options. Custom policies, notification choices, delivery methods and timings reset. Sending starts off and no destinations are supplied.
upgrade.history: Compatible history retained; monitoring removed by the reset is recorded as removed.
upgrade.delivery: Old pending/outbox alerts are canceled; only existing message cleanup may run.
upgrade.guard: Current settings remain unchanged. Mixed-format and malformed settings fail without reset.
upgrade.recovery: Use matching Home Assistant backup and component version for rollback.

installation.installed_from: Published release archive; all 77 component files matched verified package hashes
installation.rendered_review: Chrome Policies page shows all eight defaults, six enabled and Batteries/Vacuums off; global sending off.

history.limit: Normal 100-record/30-day retention applies. New reset/startup records displaced older records; pre-reset full backup retains the earlier state.

limits: Physical Safari and live notification-provider delivery were not tested.
The earlier development receipt retains its historical failures; exact-candidate CI supersedes those gate results.
